title: ID0413642-DC/Si-D/FI-[lpuy1j] Plugit- After reboot OCPP communication did not work
description:
Charger (
lpuy1j
) was offline in their backend. From our perspective it was running fine. OCPP connection was ok and all outlets were ok. (Picture1)
I investigated it more and last night charger did automated reboot. Charger sent "
PerformingCollaboratedReboot"
StatusNotification- message like it should. After that when charger came back alive, charger did not send anymore BootNotification, StatusNotification or heartbeat-messages.
Customer sent from their OCPP server command "
TriggerMessage ( - {"requestedMessage":"StatusNotification"}" and it never came through. After I deleted and re-writed OCPP URL, communication started to work.
After reboot, BootNotification, statusNotification and heartbeat messages were missing. Is this single bug / event or hiding bug?
